sloka: स सज्जायुधतूणीरो वैनतेयोपरि स्थितः ।आसज्ज्य कवचं दिव्यं सहस्रार्कसमद्युति ।। ७.६.६३ ॥
transliteration: sa sajjāyudhatūṇīro vainateyopari sthitaḥ ।āsajjya kavacaṁ divyaṁ sahasrārkasamadyuti ।। 7.6.63 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lotus-eyed Nārāyaṇa fastened his two pure quivers full of arrows, his pure waist-band, and his sword, along with his excellent weapons: the conch, discus, mace, Śārṅga bow, and sword.
